errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the blue dots are located on the solid line. The dots and the line represent two separate and distinct data series, as they follow different trajectories. For instance, the solid line has a flat plateau between 2019 and 2021, while the dots continue to rise during this period.

errors.text_span: Освен това, между основните етикети са визуализирани и по-малки, неетикетирани деления, които вероятно сочат месечни или квартални точки, но без конкретни числови означения.
errors.evidence: The description claims there are minor, unlabeled tick marks on the x-axis that probably represent months or quarters. The chart only shows vertical gridlines aligned with the data points, not time-based subdivisions of the yearly labels. This is a hallucination of axis features.
